  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[True]-g[False]).mean()
for gn in w.genre.unique(): print(gn, round(est(w[w.genre!=gn]),4))
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); A=w.author_key.unique(); by={a:x for a,x in w.groupby('author_key')}; bs=[]

  d=pd.concat([by[a] for a in rng.choice(A,len(A))]); bs.append(est(d))

print(pp[pp.year>=1876].sort_values('confidence',ascending=False).passage_id.head(4).tolist(), pp[pp.year<1876].passage_id.head(2).tolist())
